research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Papaya Global is researching systems and methods for onboarding employees into organizations, as described in 'System and method for onboarding an employee into organization.' The abstract details an approach using a two-level onboarding ontology graph, which includes both non-territory-specific and territory-specific sub-graphs to facilitate automatic employee onboarding. This highlights Papaya Global’s focus on streamlining global workforce management through automated onboarding processes.

overview_description.description: Papaya Global is a SaaS fintech company providing global payroll technology and the only one with an embedded payments platform designed for the workforce needs of global enterprises. Papaya's comprehensive technology, known as Papaya Payroll OS, provides global payroll with automation, compliance, flexibility, and security. The platform gives finance teams the visibility and control to master workforce spending and payments with full liability if anything goes wrong. Papaya's integrated approach connects the dots of global payroll, unifying and standardizing data and processes from HCM and ERP tools to create a single source of truth.

about_short_description.short_description: Papaya Global is a fintech platform that provides cloud-based payroll and payments solutions for global workforce management.

product.name: Workforce OS
product.description: A cloud-based platform for managing global payroll and workforce operations, including onboarding, payroll processing, payslips, time and attendance, analytics, and journal-entry automation.

product.name: Global Payroll
product.description: A managed international payroll service that calculates salaries, taxes, benefits, and social contributions and supports statutory compliance across 180+ countries.

product.name: OnePay
product.description: A global workforce payments platform for paying employees, contractors, vendors, and authorities in local currencies across 160+ countries.

product.name: Employer of Record (EOR)
product.description: An employment service that lets companies hire and manage employees internationally without establishing local legal entities.

product.name: Contingent OS
product.description: A platform for classifying, onboarding, managing, and paying contractors, freelancers, SOW workers, and other external workers worldwide.

product.name: Contractor of Record (COR)
product.description: A compliant contractor engagement service that manages contracts, payments, local requirements, and liability for independent contractors without requiring client entities.
